host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core verification_report 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-cli --test introspection 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: sed -i 's/^enum LaterCause/pub(super) enum LaterCause/; s/^fn later_causes/pub(super) fn later_causes/' crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs && grep -n "LaterCause {\|fn later_causes" crates/athena-core/src/status/planning.rs; sed -n 1395,1420p crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs; grep -n "best_lower" crates/athena-data/src/quantity.rs
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core verification_report 2>&1 | tail -20
cargo test -p athena-core 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed|panicked" ; cargo test -p athena-cli 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|failed|panicked"
cargo test -p athena-core -p athena-cli -p xtask --locked 2>&1 | rg "test result|FAILED|failed|panicked"
cargo test -q -p athena-core -p athena-cli -p xtask --locked --no-fail-fast 2>&1 | tail -n 60
cargo test -q -p athena-core -p athena-cli -p xtask --locked --no-fail-fast > ../test-out.txt 2>&1; echo $?
